Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by failing to accurately interpret the information cited by WebSurfer. Despite data pointing to a 1989 release for Icehouse's first edition, the Planner incorrectly emphasized conflicting information about Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set (1999 edition) without appropriately distinguishing the initial release year of the Icehouse pieces system (1989). This misinterpretation led to confusion over the timeline and unnecessary iterations, even though decisive evidence from earlier steps clearly supported Icehouse being released first in 1989.
